games.name: [2 Player] Guess The Person
games.desc:
❗How to play Guess the Person 
Take turns asking questions. "Is it a man?" "Do they have brown hair?" You only press buttons. No typing.
Your opponent answers Yes or No. Then you look at THEIR board and flip down every face that cannot be it.
When one face is left on their board, guess it. The match does not end there. Your opponent gets time to make their guess too. Then both guesses are shown at the same time. You can BOTH be right.

👑 You get crowns when you win. Use crowns to buy win emotes - a dance your character does on the win screen, so the other player sees it.
🤖 Nobody to play with? Press Play Alone. A bot sits in the other seat and plays a real match.
⭐ How to play

1. Sit on a chair in the lobby
2. Pick your secret face
3. Ask, answer, flip
4. Guess their face before they guess yours
